committee: *Presentation: Resolution No. 192-38 (COR) - Senator Shelly V. Calvo
title: The presentation of Resolution No. 192-38(COR) : Relative to recognizing and commemorating Philippine Independence on June 12, 2026, recognizing the twenty-first (21st) annual Philippine Independence Day Flag-Raising Ceremony at the Guam Reef Hotel, and honoring the enduring contributions of the Filipino community to Guam, will take place as follows: Date: Friday, June 12, 2026 Time: 07:30 AM Location: Guam Reef Hotel Your presence is respectfully requested as we honor Philippine Independence Day during the 21st Annual Flag-Raising Ceremony 6/11/26 4:12 P.M. (FN)
